title: Fraternal Lodge Officers, 1950s B&W Snapshot, Birmingham AL
description: A black and white photograph from February 1952 capturing four men dressed in tuxedos and suits wearing ceremonial collars or chains of office, likely officers of a local fraternal organization or lodge. They are pictured indoors in front of decorative curtains with pine motifs. The back is stamped by Lollar's photo processing in Birmingham, Alabama.
